facebook.caption:
4.8 stars. 4,044 reviews. At a restaurant inside Grand World Phú Quốc.

Mai Hương Restaurant is not flying under the radar. It's just that most tourists walk past and pick the flashier-looking spots.

Don't do that.

4,044 people have eaten here and nearly every single one left happy. That number is hard to fake.

Add this to your Grand World dinner list. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
